SELECT id, username, real_name AS realName FROM users WHERE id IN
#{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(status IN ( 'PENDING_ASSIGN', 'PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING' )), 0) AS processing, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'RESOLVED'), 0) AS resolved, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'CLOSED'), 0) AS closed, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'CANCELLED'), 0) AS cancelled, COALESCE( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN first_response_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, created_at, first_response_at ) / 60.0 END ), 1 ), 0 ) AS avgFirstResponseHours, COALESCE( SUM(created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY), 0 ) AS last30d FROM tickets WHERE creator_id = #{userId}

SELECT monthly.month, monthly.count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tickets WHERE creator_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12 ) AS monthly ORDER BY monthly.month ASC
